svg.title: An intro to the database — study visual
svg.desc: Study guide on databases: definition, key concepts, database operations, flat-file vs relational databases

g.text: Database = a lot of data collected in an organised way
Software that stores data that can be accessed and manipulated in many ways → data manager
Similar to blank on a form
Alphanumeric (text) or numeric (numbers). Can be limited to a certain length or specific values.
Flat-file = one table at a time. Relational = multiple tables linked by common fields (e.g. SQL).
3 sets: by title · by author · by subject matter
Problem: one book, three cards = terrible duplication of resources
Computerised DB: one record only → simpler, more efficient

svg.text: Section 3 · Unit 9 · An intro to the database
